name: Gansu Golden Solar Co., Ltd
summary: Gansu Golden Solar Co., Ltd engages in the research, development, and production of various photovoltaic cells and modules in China and internationally. The company offers photovoltaic glass products, fireproof glass, and door and window systems. It also provides heterojunction technology through cells and modules, as well as power plant solutions for residential, commercial, industrial, floating photovoltaics, and utility industries.
